body:
Burndown coordination snapshot, 2026-10-06 late MST. Scope: docs/plans/2026-10-07-fix-day.md. Evidence collection/recommendation only; no dispatch, integration approval, hold clearance, status mutation, or merge performed.

Assignment boundary: fix-day branch does not yet appear in local git branches; no in-scope live lease is listed. TASK-1603 and TASK-1606 are Approved. TASK-1-229 and TASK-1-230 remain Draft. Do not infer authorization to launch another worker from absent leases: the plan owns one interactive implementation session. TASK-1607 lease 01a1140e on story-1485 remains present and untouched; ps calls it dormant, not an invitation to redispatch. Backlog, TASK-1333 and slice A remain outside today's scope.

Plan corrections / potential release candidates:
1. PR-2444 / TASK-1602 is already MERGED (2026-10-07T03:39:38Z), head e147661860ec. Local verdict is Approved at exactly that head; Build and clearance runs succeeded. Aida currently shows TASK-1602 Done and still queued implementer position 11: record as bookkeeping discrepancy, not new implementation work.
2. PR-2435 head 6fa035c26b73 is OPEN, current Ubuntu Build and merge-hold-gate SUCCESS. Local corpus is Approved at that head, explicitly records the patch-identical rebase, and retained round 0 NOW has recorded_by=codex reviewer plus recorded_at=2026-10-06T04:48:12.629207158+00:00. The plan's missing-provenance data blocker no longer matches current local state. This is a candidate for primary-advisor/operator ship-readiness check; I did not run reconciliation or ship and cannot establish that the writer-path repair is complete.

Fix-day combined batch:
3. PR-2445 / TASK-1603 at eec6fca71808: Ubuntu SUCCESS (run 37568069064), hold gate red. Implementer reports 94 targeted tests passing, including delayed-child batch/nextN selection, two concurrent tokens, cleanup interleavings and stale snapshots. Actual retained verdict is RequestChanges at OLD a760a2016b1c, not the current head. The latest review attempt failed on OVERVIEW.md rebase before review. Keep both doc paragraphs when incorporating into fix-day FIRST; obtain whole-branch review evidence for both P1 brief items. Green CI is not rework acceptance.
4. PR-2450 / TASK-1606 at 431763d3c83d: Ubuntu FAILURE, run 37560853513. Log independently confirms six task_1287_label_only_merge_hold failures: gitlab_ship_rejects_unlisted_failures_and_unavailable_job_rows; gitlab_ship_refines_failed_watcher_for_informational_jobs; label_only_hold_is_refused_without_a_human_at_a_terminal; no_label_and_no_marker_ships_without_release; ship_ignores_pending_informational_jobs_before_coarse_watch; ship_still_rejects_required_informational_and_unlisted_failures. No local PR-2450 verdict artifact. TASK-1602 prerequisite is merged; preserve its ownership --wait behavior when integrating the preflight/CI deadline behavior.
5. TASK-1-229: need reopen->pull unchanged-status regression and TASK-1538/STORY-1488 acceptance after repair. TASK-1-230: need role/branch/delegation failures before mutations and manual-continuation evidence. No implementation evidence collected yet for either.

Recommendation: preserve plan order and ONE reviewed fix-day reliability unit, with PR-2435 considered separately only through the plan's explicit ship path and primary advisor/operator decision. Do not treat PR-2445 or PR-2450 as independently release-ready. End-of-day evidence remains cargo test --workspace, make check-ci-fast, two sandbox three-spec drains with shipped/launch-refused/other counts, and whole-branch review at final SHA before the one PR/operator merge. No real-store drains.

Measured telemetry since 2026-10-03 now contains 39 runs: 18 success, 21 failed; 10 launch-refused, 3 ci-unavailable, 3 request-changes, 2 ci-red, 1 tool-exit, 1 no-pr, 1 stale-base-conflict. Keep plan baseline (37/17/20) frozen for comparison and report newer totals separately. aida schedule due --seat advisor currently says nothing due. New observations should be captured in the fix-day notes file by the plan-owning session, not filed as new specs today.
